write_read_verify.write: producer artifact is handed off to a separate workflow_run custodian; only validated bundles are re-preserved as custody artifacts
write_read_verify.read: custody verifier downloads the custody artifact from the custodian workflow run using actions:read
write_read_verify.verify: trusted-main custody code revalidates event chain, bundle hash, receipt hash, source commit, producer run identity and custody run identity
write_read_verify.loss_detection: missing producer or custody artifact causes workflow failure and no verification PASS
write_read_verify.denied_write: invalid bundle, forged authority, unexpected runtime identity, missing event or contradictory effect semantics are rejected before custody receipt creation

retention.legal_hold_rule: If evidence must outlive the reference retention window, export to an approved long-lived custodian before expiry.
retention.deletion_rule: Deletion/expiry is a custody lifecycle action; historical receipt metadata must not be rewritten to imply evidence never existed.
retention.personal_data_default: PROHIBITED_BY_DESIGN; use pseudonymous subject_ref and minimization metadata only

credential_lifecycle.rotation: new platform-scoped job credentials are issued per workflow execution; no runtime-held storage administrator credential is used

scope_limit: This profile verifies independent custody for the CDX reference evidence pipeline. It does not prove downstream estate runtime binding or replace repository-protection blocker CDX-BLOCK-REPO-PROTECTION-001.
